"""Original camera-guided microwave closing controller; no resets or simulator state."""
import json, pathlib, sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
cams=list(spec['cameras'])

def save(res,label):
    res.save(str(OUT/label))
    for c,im in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/(label+'_'+c+'.png'))
    print(json.dumps(res.meta),flush=True)
    return res

if __name__=='__main__':
    save(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none'),'initial')

"""Estimate visible vertical door plane from calibrated RGB-D only."""
import json,sys,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
root='/app/output/'
for label in sys.argv[1:]:
 m=json.load(open(root+label+'/meta.json'));cloud=[]
 for c in ['robot0_agentview_left','robot0_agentview_center','robot0_agentview_right']:
  d=np.load(root+label+'/depth_'+c+'.npy');d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
  K=np.array(m['cameras'][c]['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(m['cameras'][c]['cam2world_gl']);im=np.asarray(Image.open(root+label+'_'+c+'.png')).astype(float)
  v,u=np.mgrid[:240,:320];q=np.stack([(u-160)*d/K[0,0],-(v-120)*d/K[1,1],-d,np.ones_like(d)],-1)@T.T
  mask=(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,1]*1.8)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,2]*1.8)&(q[:,:,2]>1.35)&(q[:,:,2]<1.68)&(q[:,:,1]>-2.76)&(q[:,:,1]<-2.25)&(q[:,:,0]>1.4)&(q[:,:,0]<2.15)&(d<3)
  cloud.append(q[mask,:3])
 p=np.concatenate(cloud);rng=np.random.default_rng(42);xy=p[::3,:2];best=0
 for _ in range(600):
  a,b=xy[rng.choice(len(xy),2,replace=False)];v=b-a;n=np.array([-v[1],v[0]]);n/=max(np.linalg.norm(n),1e-10);d=-a@n;mask=abs(xy@n+d)<.0025;k=mask.sum()
  if k>best:best=k;bn=n;bd=d
 mask=abs(p[:,:2]@bn+bd)<.003;inl=p[mask];cen=inl[:,:2].mean(0);_,_,V=np.linalg.svd(inl[:,:2]-cen,full_matrices=False);n=V[-1];print(label,'angle_to_closed_deg',np.degrees(np.arctan2(abs(n[0]),abs(n[1]))),'normal_xy',n,'center',cen,'points',len(inl),'extent',np.quantile(inl,[0,.5,1],axis=0).tolist())
